risk_score.rationale: High-risk NetWitness alert (score 70) shows suspicious executable and PowerShell/HTA activity from Public/Downloads paths with internal network communication to port 8888 and multiple matching IOCs, making initiation, recurrence, and adverse impact highly likely.

incident_details.title: High Risk Alerts: NetWitness Endpoint for KELLYWANG
incident_details.description: Endpoint telemetry shows a suspicious process chain involving splunkd.exe running from Public/Downloads paths with PowerShell-style download behavior to an internal host on port 8888. The presence of HTA and PowerShell indicators, along with unusual command-line activity under a user context, suggests likely malicious execution or post-compromise activity, but there is no clear evidence of active destructive impact or confirmed exfiltration.
